core_obligations: Show that the extended maximal ideal is maximal and lies in the Jacobson radical, so that the ring is local (proof lines 3118-3122).
Give the first finish by identifying the two colimit constructions (proof lines 3126-3128).
Give the second finish by verifying that both candidates are filtered colimits of etale algebras, are henselian local, and have the same residue field (proof lines 3129-3136).
Apply the uniqueness statement for henselian local rings to obtain the canonical isomorphism (proof lines 3137-3139).
proof_roadmap: Locality and the maximal ideal (proof lines 3118-3122).
Second proof: uniqueness of the henselian local ring (proof lines 3129-3139).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the henselization of a local ring with the henselization of the associated pair. The statement carries a slogan explaining the compatibility, and the proof first checks that the maximal ideal extends to a maximal ideal of the constructed henselization which lies in the Jacobson radical, so that the ring is local with that maximal ideal. Two alternative finishes are then given: the first observes that the two colimit constructions are literally the same, and the second verifies that both candidate rings are filtered colimits of etale algebras, are henselian local with the same residue field, and therefore are canonically isomorphic by the uniqueness of the henselian local ring with prescribed properties.
